color.note: One night theme: the site is dark by design. Teal is the wave and every active state; violet is a rare accent mark; stone belongs to the old city and to prototype status.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every section and the hero scrim's solid end.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the assistant sheet, the nav after scroll.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Chat wells, the execution log, illustrative UI mock-ups inside cards.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for rows, options and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and panel edges only. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, options, chips and secondary buttons; at least 3:1 on bg, bg-raised and bg-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on bg, bg-raised, bg-sunken and bg-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, secondary copy and inactive tab labels on any bg token.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and placeholder text on any bg token (4.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: wave
tokens.usage: The electric wave line, the primary button fill, selected options, completed steps. As text on any bg token.

tokens.name: wave-bright
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, the focus ring, the wave's leading pulse.

tokens.name: wave-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a selected option or the active step; ink, wave and ink-muted stay legible on it.

tokens.name: on-wave
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on a wave or wave-bright fill (9:1). Never white on teal.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Accent marks only: the wave's trailing echo, the lab section rule, chart signal dots. Not for text (4.4:1).

tokens.name: violet-text
tokens.usage: Violet text and lab-status labels on any bg token and on violet-soft.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the in-development status and the WIS Lab band.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Old-city accent and the prototype status label; as text on any bg token and on stone-soft.

tokens.name: stone-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the prototype status tag.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting states (awaiting confirmation); always beside a word and an icon. Text on any bg token and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a waiting step or notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors in the simulation (tool outage, slot unavailable); always with a word and an icon. Text on any bg token and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an error step or notice.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed steps and confirmations: an alias of wave, so success stays blue-green and is never told apart from danger by hue alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Solid end of the navy scrim behind the headline over the present photo (88% bg).

tokens.name: ink-dark
tokens.usage: Headline, brand and nav over the past (sunset) photo only. 5.7:1 or better on its sky.

tokens.name: ink-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Description and inactive nav over the past (sunset) photo only. 5.2:1 or better on its sky.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The one data line in illustrative charts (Trading WIS). A darker wave step that passes the dark-surface lightness band; text never wears it.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Signal markers in illustrative charts, r 4 with a 2px bg-sunken ring. Always with a legend key.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Glow of the hero wave between the past and the present. Never UI.

tokens.name: spark-violet
tokens.usage: The wave's thin trailing echo. Never UI.

families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Arabic never takes letter-spacing: it breaks the joins. Leading stays at 1.3 or more.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: انقل أعمالك إلى عصر الوكلاء الذكيين.
styles.usage: The hero headline on desktop only.

styles.name: display-mobile
styles.sample: انقل أعمالك إلى عصر الوكلاء الذكيين.
styles.usage: The hero headline at phone width.

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: ابدأ بالتحدّي الذي يستهلك وقت فريقك
styles.usage: One per section, under the eyebrow. 28px at phone width.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel and card titles, the lab heading.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Option titles, step names, project names.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: نصمّم ونطوّر وكلاء ذكاء اصطناعي يتكاملون مع أنظمة شركتك.
styles.usage: Hero description and section lead paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: يتحقق من المواعيد في نظام مرتبط.
styles.usage: Default copy, chat messages, panel text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Option descriptions, log details, card meta.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav links, chip labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The short label above a section title, in wave.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Tool names and raw values inside the execution log only.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sections breathe at space-30; panels pad at space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a title and its description; chat bubble gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding block; list row gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; card inner padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between the two columns of a section.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on desktop.

radius.note: Architectural: crisp corners, small radii. Pills only for tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status tags, log markers, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, options, chat bubbles, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the assistant sheet, phone surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, the scroll cue, step nodes.

shadow.note: Depth comes from surface steps, not shadows. Glow is rationed: the wave line and the selected node only.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Raised panels and cards.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The assistant sheet and anything floating over the hero.

tokens.name: glow-wave
tokens.usage: The selected agent part and the active step node. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px ground gap, then 2px wave-bright (box-shadow, follows the radius).

layout.note: Frame sizes the screens are drawn at, and the touch floor.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width on desktop (1440 frame minus two space-20 gutters).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Desktop nav bar; 60px on phone.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable, including the assistant's close button.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body-lg and body paragraphs.
